comment: Files in another runtime that mhw keeps on purpose: test fixtures, never mhw's own code (D5 of docs/mhw-product-requirements-document-node-runtime.md, #470). Each entry is a tracked path and why it stays. test/project-policy/delivery-gate.test.js fails when a listed path does not exist (a stale exemption) and when a .py file under global/project-policy/ is not listed. The CI check over the whole tree is S32's (#502).

fixtures.why: The reference CI/CD's synthetic project: the application its dry run gates. A project's code is in whatever language that project uses; the gates are Node and never import it.
The synthetic project's containerised test command, run inside its own python image by reference-delivery-dry-run.yml; it writes the evidence file the Node container gate reads.
The synthetic project's installed-STG stand-in, run on the runner by reference-delivery-dry-run.yml; it writes the evidence file the Node installed-stg gate reads.
